{"rules": ["Model consistently overestimates price by ~5-8 EUR when recent history shows a downward trend (e.g., dropping from 79 to 70).", "Forecast fails to capture the 'V-shaped' recovery pattern; it predicts a slow, linear decline while true outcomes spike sharply upward after hitting lows.", "Sentiment spikes (0.25-0.33) in the last 3 days of history correlate with immediate price drops in the forecast but are ignored by the model's trend logic.", "Model exhibits strong mean-reversion bias toward a lower baseline (~71 EUR) rather than following the actual volatility range (65-80 EUR).", "Forecast horizon is too long-term; it smooths out short-term spikes that occur within the first 10 days of the 30-day window.", "When sentiment history shows mixed signals (mostly 0.00 with occasional low positives), the model assumes stability, but true outcomes show high volatility and sudden reversals."]
